title: 2.4.19 Multiples of 3 with continue
description: Loop over 1 to 20 and print only the multiples of 3, using continue to skip the rest. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Loop 1 to 20
steps.instructions: Write a for loop running from 1 to 20.

steps.title: Skip the non-multiples with continue
steps.instructions: Inside the loop, if the current number is not a multiple of 3, use continue to skip it. Otherwise, log the number.

planChart.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A([Start]) --> B[i starts at 1]
  B --> C{i is 20 or less}
  C -- yes --> D{i is a multiple of 3}
  C -- no --> G([End])
  D -- yes --> E[/log i/]
  D -- no --> F[go to the next i]
  E --> F
  F --> C

In a met note, say in one short phrase what in their code satisfied it. Do not use generic praise.
